chunks: "Salat (prayer) is three thirds: one third is purification, one third is bowing, and one third is prostration."

key_terms.أَثْلَاثٍ: thirds or three parts, describing the composition of prayer
key_terms.اَلصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship being described
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ: three, indicating the division mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.رُكُوعٌ: ruku', the bowing posture in salat (prayer)
key_terms.طَهُورٌ: ritual purity or purification, a foundational prerequisite of prayer

ai.seo_question: What are the essential parts of salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes salat (prayer) as being composed of three essential parts: taharah (ritual purity), ruku' (bowing), and sujud (prostration). It highlights the foundational role of purification and the central physical acts of devotion within the structure of prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.66 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The prayer consists of three parts: one-third is for purification, one-third is for bowing (ruku), and one-third is for prostration (sujud) "
